instrument: アコースティックギター
notes_ja: 【チューニング】レギュラー（EADGBE）、カポなし。録音はA=440よりわずかに高め（+3〜6セント）ですが、普通に440で合わせて大丈夫です。【1〜11小節（イントロ）】中央に1本だけのアコギ。ダウンは4弦開放（D）と3弦2フレット（A）の2本（xx02xx）、アップは3弦（A）だけを軽く弾き、4弦のDは鳴らしっぱなしにします。右手は12/8のジグ・ストローク「ダウン（付点4分の頭）→アップ（3つ目の8分）」＝1拍を「タ・ン・タ」で、ダウン位置0・3・6・9、アップ位置2・5・8・11。小節によってアップを抜くところがあるので譜面どおりに。8〜11小節の頭だけ2弦3フレット（D）も一緒に鳴らします。11小節は0・2・3、後半は6・7・8・9・11と細かく刻んで12小節に入ります。【12〜19小節（A）】ここから左右に2本のアコギ（ほぼ同じパターンのダブル）。この譜面は左のギターです。D5＝x0023x（5弦開放A・4弦開放D・3弦2f・2弦3f、1弦はミュート）。右手はイントロと同じ「ダウン・アップ」のジグ。13・15・17小節の後半は3x00x1（6弦3f、4・3弦開放、1弦1f）に替え、ベースとドラムと同じく4分音符3つ（位置6・8・10）をすべてダウンで弾くヘミオラ。1弦1fは人差し指を少し寝かせて押さえ、2弦（B）と5弦は鳴らさないようにミュートします。原曲のギターはここで2弦のC音をほとんど鳴らしていません（3x0011のセーハで弾いても響きは大きく変わりません）。18小節〜19小節前半はx00011（5弦開放、2・1弦1fセーハ）、19小節後半は1弦を鳴らさないx0001x（1弦は人差し指の先でミュート。開放Eは鳴らしません）。19小節後半のリズムは6・8・9・11。【20〜34小節（B）】形はD5（x0023x）・G（3x0033）・Bm（xx4432、31小節だけ5弦2fも入れてx24432）・Asus2（x0220x）／Asus4（x0223x）・A（x0222x）。どの形も1弦の開放Eは鳴らしません。右手は付点4分ごとのダウン（0・3・6・9）が基本で、1拍目と3拍目（0と6）を強く。ところどころ位置5や11に軽いアップが入ります。20小節は0・3・6の3回だけ。24小節後半はAsus4（x0223x）のまま（右のギターはAsus2寄り）、27小節はAsus4→Asus2（位置3）→Asus4（位置6、ベースがEに下りるところ）と2弦3fの指を離したり付けたりします。28小節と31小節の後半はベースと同じ4分音符3つ（6・8・10、すべてダウン）。30・33小節後半は左のギターをA（x0222x）としましたが、2弦は開放B（Asus2）も同じくらい聞こえ、右のギターははっきりAsus2です。どちらで弾いても合います。【全体】どのコードも次のストロークまで鳴らしたまま（レット・リング）。実際のストロークは拍より20〜30msほど早く低音弦から入る、少し走り気味の弾き方です。ダウン／アップの向きは12/8の一般的な弾き方に合わせた推定です。【コード名について】譜面のコード名はベースとバイオリンを含めた全体の響きで付けています（全パート共通）。ギターの実際の形はTABとダイアグラムのとおりで、Csus2の所は3x00x1（Cはベース、ギターは1弦1フレットのFを足す＝正確にはCsus4(add9)）、Am7の所はx00011（AにD・G・C・F）、DとGの所は3度を弾かないx0023xと3x0033です。
method: SOURCE: MVSep Mega-53 acoustic-guitar stem (main), cross-checked with BS-RoFormer SW guitar and htdemucs_6s guitar; left and right channels analysed separately. INSTRUMENT: plucked/strummed acoustic guitar, not a pad: strong strums show +15..+24 dB jumps in the 2.5-8 kHz band with 14-27 ms 10-90% rise (strum spread) and -9..-23 dB decay within 300 ms (bars 22/23/29, both channels); mid band +7..+13 dB, 32-101 ms rise, -7..-13 dB/300 ms; a broad 100-108 Hz body thump pulses with every intro strum. LAYOUT: bars 1-11 one centred guitar (L/R correlation 0.75-0.92 per half bar, 100-3000 Hz); from bar 12 two hard-panned guitars (correlation -0.28..0.19), double-tracked with small differences; this part follows the left guitar where they differ. TUNING: standard EADGBE, no capo (+3..+6 c). No D2 anywhere (D2 -35 dB re D3 in bars 1-6 without bass), A2 is the lowest note of every D chord, open high E absent from all chords (E4 3-22 dB in Mega vs D4 25-43), Bm = (x)x4432, and the Asus2/Asus4 tones B3 and D4 alternate in time (bar 27: B3 at pos 2-5, D4 at 0-1 and 6-9), which a single 2nd string explains; DADGAD was considered and rejected (no D2 drone, Bm shape). VOICINGS from basic-pitch posteriors (min over 5 channel/stem sources) and long-window levels: intro D3+A3 only (D4/A4 in the stem are the violin and the h2 of D3/A3; D4 added on the bar-start downstroke in 8-11, posterior 0.46-0.58); A: x0023x; 13b/15b/17b G2 D3 G3 F4 = 3x00x1 (the weak C4 in the guitar stems is leakage of the loud C4 in the mix; see verification), F4 measured +17..+20 c (sharp first-fret note) in L, R and Demucs; 18-19a x00011, 19b x0001x (see verification); B: x0023x (F#4 in SW/Demucs is bass D2 h5 leakage, absent in Mega), 3x0033 (B3 ~12 dB below G3), xx4432/x24432, x0220x/x0223x, x0222x (L) vs x0220x (R) in 30b/33b. The strong C4 in 13b/15b/17b of the mix (58 dB) is not in any guitar stem (<=19 dB) and comes from the residual (violin double stop / other), so the old pad's G3-C4-G4 'Csus2' is not the guitar. RHYTHM: attacks = peaks of the 2.5-8 kHz rise per channel, quantised with a +0.2-eighth offset (strums lead the grid by ~25 ms), kept when seen in >=3 of ag_L/ag_R/swg_L/swg_R or in both Mega channels (intro: ag/swg/dg plus A3-band rises). Directions are inferred from the jig convention (down on 0/3/6/9, up on the third eighth, hemiola quarters all down); string-order timing was too noisy to confirm. Upstrokes are written as the top 3 strings (intro: the 3rd string A3 only). EVAL (per bar onsetF vs consensus attacks / min half-bar chroma vs Mega stem): 1:1.00/0.88 2:0.92/0.80 3:0.93/0.83 4:1.00/0.84 5:1.00/0.80 6:1.00/0.88 7:1.00/0.70 8:1.00/0.71 9:0.83/0.77 10:0.92/0.84 11:1.00/0.74 12:0.89/0.90 13:1.00/0.88 14:0.94/0.85 15:0.94/0.89 16:0.78/0.93 17:0.93/0.90 18:0.84/0.85 19:0.95/0.83 20:0.86/0.87 21:0.91/0.90 22:1.00/0.86 23:0.75/0.91 24:0.86/0.88 25:1.00/0.92 26:0.80/0.90 27:0.82/0.83 28:0.91/0.80 29:0.83/0.95 30:1.00/0.87 31:1.00/0.86 32:1.00/0.93 33:0.94/0.84 34:0.89/0.89. Means: intro F 0.96 chroma 0.83 (G#2 body rumble lowers chroma), A F 0.90 chroma 0.90, B F 0.91 chroma 0.90; old arranged guitar.json: 0.71/0.75, 0.84/0.84, 0.74/0.84; old pad.json: 0.28/0.74, 0.35/0.84, 0.33/0.88. NOTE: events, voicings and the bar-27 chord timing were revised in verification; the EVAL numbers above are the transcriber's pre-verification values; see 'verification' for the current ones.

verification:
Independent verification (scripts and images in work/v3/verify_gtr/, v01-v45; backup of the checked file: parts_v3/guitar.pre_verify.json). Evidence used: the htdemucs_6s and BS-RoFormer SW guitar stems (left and right channels separately) as the main stems, with the Mega acoustic-guitar and guitar stems for comparison, the Mega violin stem, the SW drums and SW bass stems, and the mix. Tools differ from the transcriber's: CQT superflux, harmonic-partial flux (chord-partial bins minus noise bins), 4-8 kHz post-attack sustained rise, librosa onset detection, NNLS harmonic-template decomposition, band-pass Hilbert envelopes of single notes, and 16k-FFT note levels with cents.

CONFIRMED: strummed acoustic guitar; standard tuning with no capo; a centred guitar in bars 1-11, then two hard-panned guitars (Mega 60-1500 Hz L/R correlation 0.90 in bars 1-11, 0.18 in bars 12-19, 0.06 in bars 20-34); intro dyad D3+A3; G = 3x0033 (no B2; B3 12-22 dB below G3 in bars 21, 23, 25, 29 and 32, so the 2nd string is not open); Bm shapes; 13b/15b/17b and 28b hemiola.
- D4 on the bar-start downstroke of bars 8-11 is real. D4-D3 in the Mega stem is -0.7, -5.4, +7.6 and +1.8 dB there, against -20 to -32 dB at the bar starts of bars 1-6. The violin's own D4 is 4-31 dB below the guitar-stem D4, so it is not violin leakage.
- The rhythm mostly agrees with a left-channel 4-8 kHz attack detector that needs 2 of ag_L, swg_L and dg_L (slot F 0.925 at a 6 dB threshold).

CHANGES (221 -> 210 events)
(1) Intro upstrokes now sound only the 3rd string (A3, tab [3,2]); notes_ja already described this. Level jump measured 45-90 ms after vs before each stroke, median of three stems:
- A3: +4.1 dB at upstrokes, +5.5 dB at beat downstrokes.
- D3: -1.0 dB at upstrokes (4 of 26 above +3 dB), +1.5 dB at downstrokes (17 of 42 above +3 dB).

(2) Removed 13 light strokes that the left guitar does not support. Directions were re-derived with the transcriber's jig convention.

| Strokes removed | Reason |
|---|---|
| 2.8, 3.10, 11.10, 16.5, 18.5, 20.5, 24.11, 29.11 | At least 2 of 3 measures at noise level and none at presence level (see M1-M3 below). |
| 14.11, 19.10, 25.11, 33.2 | Right guitar only, or a short transient with no sustain that coincides with a snare or shaker hit. Listed in right_guitar_differences. |
| 31.9 | Bar 31b is now the 6-8-10 hemiola, like 28b under the same B-A-G bass walk. The HF rise at pos 9 occurs in both bars together with a violin onset, with a sustained rise of about 0 and only 8 dB in the Demucs L stem. |

The three measures for the first row:
- M1: median 4-8 kHz rise over 4 left stems below 8 dB (transcribed strokes: 10th percentile 11 dB, median 18.6 dB).
- M2: sustained-rise score below 0.
- M3: independent CQT/harmonic-flux consensus below 0.12.

New directions after these removals: 3.11, 11.11 and 19.11 are upstrokes; 31.8 and 31.10 are hemiola downstrokes.

(3) Added two strokes.
- 20.3, D5 downstroke. 4-8 kHz rise: ag_L 16.7, mg_L 16.6, dg_L 10.0 dB. Sustained rise +10.4 dB. Drums only 7.2 dB.
- 11.2, upstroke. M1 11.9 dB, M2 1.10, M3 0.25; visible in all three stems.

(4) 13b/15b/17b: 3x0011 -> 3x00x1 (G2 D3 G3 F4; no C4). The C4 in the guitar stems is leakage of the loud C4 in the mix:
- C4 is 9-15 dB below F4 here, while C4 is about as loud as F4 under the same fret-1 barre in bars 18-19.
- The guitar-stem C4 is 36-38 dB below the mix C4 (113 dB). This is the same ratio as the leakage of the violin's G4 (-40 to -41 dB).
- Its cents (+11 to +38) follow the mix C4 (+16), not the guitar's tuning.

F4 is a real guitar note: Mega L/R 85/80 dB against 83 dB in the mix, and it is re-attacked at pos 6, 8 and 10.

(5) 19b: x00010 -> x0001x (A2 D3 G3 C4). E4 stays at the level of the A2 3rd harmonic:

| Stem | E4 in 18b | E4 in 19a | E4 in 19b | F4 in 19a | F4 in 19b |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mega L | 67 | 68 | 68 | 76 | 64 |
| Mega R | 72 | 63 | 64 | 71 | 59 |

The 1st string stops sounding, but no open E is played.

(6) Bar 27: Asus4 now returns at pos 6, with the bass E, not at pos 8. D4-B3 per eighth in the left channel (ag / dg / swg):
- eighth 0: +15 / +20 / +16 dB;
- eighths 2-5: -7 to +4 dB;
- eighths 6-9: +10 to +23 dB.

Event 27.6 is now x0223x and the guitar chord moved from 27.8 to 27.6.

(7) Confidence: bars 13, 15, 17, 20 and 31 are now medium.

UNRESOLVED (left as transcribed)
- 30b/33b, left guitar: A (x0222x) or Asus2. The Mega L stem has B3 5-13 dB above C#4; the Demucs L stem has C#4 up to 10 dB above B3.
- 24b: the left channel has D4 >= B3 already at pos 6-7, so Asus4 throughout is possible.
- 27.11: B3 is dominant (-6 to -13 dB D4-B3), probably the open string ringing during the chord change.
- 20.10, 22.11, 23.3 and 30.3 may be light strokes (13-17 dB 4-8 kHz rises), but the sustained-rise measure and the independent detector disagree, so they were not added.
- Strum direction stays a convention. A direction test (onset lag of D3 vs A3 in the intro) did not separate the two: beat downstrokes median -4.5 ms (IQR -21 to 7), upstrokes -7.0 ms (IQR -33 to 14).

- Largest stretch: the x24432 barre.
